title: Compact Euclidean LSI-to-PI linearization
source_anchor: Exercise 1.7/(1.E.1), printed 43/PDF 55; §2.1.1 compact inequalities, printed 48–49/PDF 60–61; August 20, 2026; PDF 8818e8fb40c07bd70651bafe10e8ec4500197c836928330b90025ca47da52fae
target_statement: Let E be a finite-dimensional complete real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure, μ a probability measure on E, and C a fixed positive real. Assume the homogeneous function logarithmic Sobolev inequality Entμ(v²) ≤ 2C ∫‖∇v‖² dμ for every compactly supported smooth real v. Then every compactly supported smooth real g has centered second moment ∫(g−∫g dμ)² dμ ≤ C∫‖∇g‖² dμ. No zero-mean condition is imposed on g.
